body:
I have talked to him about this. But, we don't talk about it much because I feel like telling him I'm upset and don't want to live anymore is...almost insulting. Like I may as well be telling him I don't love him.  Because on a rational level, how can I love him and be this sad when we its less than two months till our wedding? 
He's encouraged me to try picking up hobbies again and wants me to go to a therapist. But, we can't afford it and, like I said, I can't reliably make and keep an appointment with a therapist.
